description: Maryland licensed Child Care Center metadata/count prerequisites; no facility-row acquisition.

output_schema_contract.row_unit: source rows, not unique active businesses
output_schema_contract.coordinates: native layer reference only; no business geometry or coordinate acquisition

redirect_policy: Reject redirects; fixed anonymous item, layer and center-count URLs only.
retry: No retries or endpoint fallback; provider deferrals and changing source contracts stop readiness.
checkpoint: Publish only a complete independently validated immutable receipt; retain item metadata unchanged and selected layer schema/count evidence.
idempotency: UUID-scoped receipts; no replacement of source, enrollment or national pointers.
cancellation: Abort transport and pacing cooperatively; await local writers and preserve uncertain postcommit publication for inspection.
retention_profile: Internal immutable metadata/count evidence with complete dataset item metadata and notices; no facility records.

source_contract.description:
This layer contains all Child Care Providers licensed by the Maryland State Department of Education, Division of Early Childhood, Office of Child Care as of 02-13-2026. An up-to-date list can be found at: https://www.checkccmd.org/ 

The data was obtained via API from: https://findaprogram.marylandexcels.org/
